note: The screens a compatibility session promises to render like the oracle, and the terms on which a capture pair may be compared. Owned by clonk-org/clonk-rs#587; the presentation promise in profile.json names that issue as pending evidence, and this file is the detail behind it.

capture.note: One resolution and scale for every screen: a comparison across different geometry proves nothing, and 1280x720 at scale 100 is what docs/RENDERING_PARITY.md's live C++ captures already use.

tolerance.note: The software renderer is the exact oracle, so a CPU capture may not differ at all. GPU composition carries the one-byte cross-driver tolerance docs/RENDERING_PARITY.md already documents for readback.

blocker.summary: Compared 2026-08-26 against the pinned oracle: 95.94% bit-identical. Every remaining pixel is the port's own branding - its Logo.png, its version string and its footer line - plus the mouse cursor the C++ F9 capture bakes in. Excluding those four regions, 823144 pixels are 99.93% bit-identical, 100.00% within one channel step, and no pixel differs by more than one. The renderer already meets the GPU term; the product identity is what a comparison cannot pass.

screens.description: Scenario selection subtree, including the folder listing and the selected-scenario panel.

blocker.summary: Compared 2026-08-26 against the pinned oracle: 2.06% bit-identical. The widgets match; the background does not, because planet/Graphics.c4g StartupScenSelBG.png is 2400x1800 in the port and 800x600 at the pin (commit d239bbb9d, 'super-resolve the stretched startup menu art'). Different source art cannot meet a zero-delta term at any resolution.

Compared 2026-08-26 against the pinned oracle: 5.90% bit-identical, same cause as startup-scenario-selection - StartupNetworkBG.png is 2400x1800 in the port and 800x600 at the pin. This screen additionally lists live master-server games, so its content is not reproducible without a pinned server list.

Compared 2026-08-26 against the pinned oracle: 3.96% bit-identical, same cause as startup-scenario-selection - StartupPlrSelBG.png is 2400x1800 in the port and 800x600 at the pin. The button row and the player entry match exactly; the difference is the background texture throughout.
Compared 2026-08-26 against the pinned oracle: 63.08% bit-identical. The paper sheet the options rows sit on is StartupDlgPaper.png, 1884x1449 in the port and 628x483 at the pin.
Compared 2026-08-26 against the pinned oracle: 81.44% bit-identical. Same StartupDlgPaper.png divergence as startup-options, over a smaller sheet area, plus the port's own credits text.
